name: Welcome & Name
starter: # Assignment: recreate the three-line welcome program.
# See the instructions on the right, then click Test Code.
instructions: Write a three-line program that greets the user by name:
• Ask for the user's name with input("Please enter your name?") and store it in a variable called user
• Print Welcome, the name, then You will learn a lot about Python here! using a single print(...) with commas

tests.name: Uses input() to read the name
Stores the input in a variable
Greets the entered name correctly (entered "Ada")
